test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A retailer mixes 50 kg of sugar costing 45 per kg with a certain quantity of sugar costing 60 per kg. If he sells the mixture at 62 per kg, making a 24 percent profit, what quantity of the second type of sugar did he mix?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of first type of sugar = 45 per kg

Quantity of first type of sugar = 50 kg

Cost of second type of sugar = 60 per kg

Selling price of mixture = 62 per kg

Profit percentage = 24%

**Formula Used:**

Cost price (CP) of mixture = Selling price (SP) ÷ (1 + Profit%)

Weighted average cost price = (Cost of first type × Quantity of first type + Cost of second type × Quantity of second
